description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Remove one photo from the website photo library for good, by its id from my_website. Refused while a product, the draft or the live website shows it: take it off there first. A saved version that showed it loses the picture if it is restored. The same picture uploaded again is the photo already there, so repeats need no removing.
name: remove_site_photo
title: Remove a website photo
